integrity: The exact 93-tetrahedron complex is embedded. Ambient mod-two H2 is reconstructed from boundary matrices, every vertex subset of size at most nine is exhaustively checked, all 37 minimizing induced complexes receive replayable elementary-collapse certificates preserving all nine vertices, and every terminal surface fundamental cycle is checked to represent the nonzero ambient class.
scientific_limitations: The result is specific to one labelled sixteen-vertex triangulation and to induced vertex support over F2. It does not classify larger supports, non-induced surfaces, or integral H2, which vanishes for this spherical space.
title: Thirty-seven shortest \(H_2(\mathbf F_2)\)-carriers collapse to genus-three surfaces in the sixteen-vertex truncated cube space
